conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a realistic ~1.5%/month outlook, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, leading to lower expected drawdowns. However, potential upside is also limited.

plan: For a balanced approach, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, PLTU, SPAL, MUU) to reduce overall leverage.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets a ~2.5%/month outlook, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while introducing a high-quality scanner setup. Expected drawdowns are moderate, balancing growth with risk management.

plan: For aggressive growth, SPY will be trimmed to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for a ~4%/month outlook, stretching for growth. It utilizes leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring scanner setups, which significantly raises both potential upside and drawdown. Be aware of daily decay/rebalancing in leveraged ETFs and the potential for rapid losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: To prioritize income, all high-beta and leveraged ETFs (METU, MSFU, SOXL, PLTU, SPAL, MUU) will be sold to zero.
SPY will be trimmed to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
QQQI will be increased to 30% to enhance monthly distribution potential.

income.read: This income plan targets a ~1%/month outlook, prioritizing steady distributions. It significantly reduces high-beta and leveraged exposure, aiming for lower drawdown and more reliable income. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in market downturns; this is not a savings account.
